notes: Spec kits written from game knowledge; every id validated by name via gameData.ability on 2026-09-27. Dungeon lists seeded from 4 sampled runs per dungeon (keys 12-20, last 10 days): avoidable = Environment-sourced or high per-player dispersion (cv >= 0.4) and not tank-concentrated (max player share < 0.8); dangerous = kicked >= 50% of the time by the population with >= 8 casts seen; filler = the rest. Re-seed each patch. Excluded from avoidable: melee, any interruptible cast (that is a kick failure), and targeted projectiles (bolts/shots). Lists carry confidence "seeded": replace with hand-curated ids as you learn the season.
